description: This file contains configuration logic for the notes backend application, specifically handling environment variable parsing to set application settings such as database file paths. It defines a Settings dataclass and a function to retrieve these settings, ensuring environment variables are accessed centrally and testably.

classes.name: Settings
classes.description: A dataclass that encapsulates configuration settings, specifically the path to the SQLite database file.

methods.name: Settings get_settings()
methods.description: Loads and returns application settings from environment variables, with default fallbacks when environment variables are missing.
